title: Drop skill_source = "plugin" so the lore skill is repo-local while opum-lore is off (DEC-238 a1)
description: DEC-238 (a1), relayed by team-lead 2026-10-25: while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a repo-local generated SKILL.md. Measured here: .lore/config.toml on origin/dev sets [agents] skill_source = "plugin" (line 54); the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json sets "opum-lore@opum": false; `lore agents --check` reports absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum, exit 0. So the checkout has NO lore skill at runtime. The edit touches this repository own governing files (tier 2), so it is our decision, not instructed. FILED ONLY: start nothing until the opum-doc plan schedules it. Do not touch settings.local.json. Return to skill_source = "plugin" only once the plugin is measured enabled in this checkout.

acceptanceCriteria.text: After the change, lore agents --check no longer reports absent-plugin-sourced (it did before) and reports the Claude skill file up-to-date
After the change, .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, generated by lore agents
After the change, lore agents --check and lore check both exit 0, with lore check measured at the CI-pinned lore version as CI runs it, not a newer local binary, and the version stated
The managed lore:agents block in CLAUDE.md is regenerated by lore agents (never hand-edited) and its Skill line names .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md instead of the opum-lore plugin
Hand-written CLAUDE.md sentences calling a .claude/skills/ copy drift, if any exist, are amended in the same change (DEC-238 a2 item 2; none found at filing time)

implementationNotes: DEC-238 (a2) amendment 2026-10-25. BEFORE-STATE measured on origin/dev 8291a945 in this checkout (so the fix is proved both ways; exit 0 proves nothing, it already passes broken): .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md absent; `lore agents --check` prints absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md / up-to-date CLAUDE.md / plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user / plugin-claude-remedy claude plugin enable opum-lore@opum --scope user, exit 0; `lore check` exit 0. CLAUDE.md has no sentence calling a .claude/skills/ copy drift (grep of skills/ hits only the opum-marketplace federation paragraph), so item 2 has nothing to amend here. Related lore bug filed separately.

DEC-238 (a3)/(a4) amendment 2026-10-25: criteria re-worded to a3. The "plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum" line is EXPECTED to remain while the 2026-10-20 override stands and is not a failure; before-state is in the earlier note. lore check is measured at the CI-pinned lore version. Template reading (a4 point 2), by source not by run: buildNudgeBody in src/core/agent-bridge.ts picks the Skill line by skillSource, so the plugin wording is written only while skill_source is plugin; the criterion above makes the regeneration prove it. No template defect found yet; reopen if the post-change block still says plugin.
